# xxHash provenance

Unmodified `xxhash.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from xxHash v0.8.3,
commit `e626a72bc2321cd320e953a0ccf1584cad60f363`:
https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash/tree/v0.8.3

SHA-256 header: `17973c0dc49d9854ca26caa191f0e12f7a424b68858d9a78de3860d959d85e4b`
SHA-256 license: `6ffedbc0f7878612d2b23589f1ff2ab15633e1df7963a5d9fc750ec5500c7e7a`

The rollback digest uses only portable XXH64 integer operations. XXH3 and
streaming APIs are excluded. No optional CPU feature or assembly path is used.
The full BSD-2-Clause notice is also included in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md for
binary packages.
